    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Barge
    Represents a Barge in the Battleship game ("Age of Discoveries" version).
    Caravel
    Represents a Caravel in the Battleship game ("Age of Discoveries" version).
    Carrack
    Represents a Carrack in the Battleship game ("Age of Discoveries" version).
    Compass
    Represents the possible orientations (compass directions) for placing a ship on the Battleship board.
    Fleet
    Represents a player's fleet of ships in the Battleship game.
    Frigate
    Represents a frigate in the fleet.
    Galleon
    Represents a galleon in the fleet.
    Game
    Implements a Battleship game for a given fleet.
    IFleet
    Represents the collection of ships that a player places on the game board.
    IGame
    Defines the operations and statistics of a Battleship game.
    IPosition
    Represents a position on the Battleship board, identified by its row and column.
    IShip
    Represents a ship in a Battleship game.
    Position
    Represents a position on a Battleship board.
    Ship
    Provides the common state and behavior of ships in a Battleship game.
    Tasks
    Provides command-driven tasks for exercising the main features of the Battleship application.
